data.summary:
**When:** Any phase, after one of your **ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER** models has used a datasheet ability limited to once per battle for each unit.

**Target:** That model.

**Effect:** The model can use that ability one more time, though in a different phase.

**Restrictions:** Each **ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER** model can be targeted by this Stratagem only once in a battle.
